fields.acceptance: With a temporary delay injected at the race (not committed), go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/headless-run-agent-tabs$' fails before the fix and passes after it on 3 consecutive runs; a new regression test in internal/api (or internal/run) that writes a session's Evidence after the cache has kept an answer, inside the debounce window, fails without the fix and passes with it; without the delay go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/headless-run-agent-tabs$' -count=5 passes, as do go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... when those packages changed; the script is not quarantined, unless the race could not be reproduced or fixed, in which case it is skipped with a bug request filed via rhiza request --kind bug and the reason written as a note on this change set
fields.statement: A leaves step judges a session that has just ended (a verifier's Evidence, a builder's or fixer's leaf commit) against a model caught up past that session's writes, never an answer the run driver's model cache (internal/api/run_model_cache.go: readModel, catchUpModel, refreshDue, revalidate) kept from before them, so a verifier that wrote Evidence while another leaf's session wrote concurrently is judged passed, and headless-run-agent-tabs no longer flakes
